messages:
Maya (support): Hi team — customer Jane from Acme hit a 500 while calling /v1/generate. She gave a request_id: req_8b7f3a2e. Can we locate server-side logs and share repro guidance?
Jane (Acme): Repro curl I used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"summarize: ...","request_id":"req_8b7f3a2e"}'``` It fails consistently at ~120ms with a 500.
Liam (eng-oncall): Thanks Maya/Jane — adding context: did the customer attach the debug bundle or the full response body? If not, ask them to send the response headers/body.
Jane (Acme): Attaching the truncated body now: `\{"error\":\"internal_server_error\",\"code\":500\}` — headers included X-Request-Id: req_8b7f3a2e and X-Region: us-east-1.
Sam (sre): Quick note on retention: our indexed logs for request_id lookups are retained for 21 days in Elasticsearch, raw archives for 90 days. After 21 days we can still pull from cold archive but it takes an ops ticket.
Liam (eng-oncall): Sam — can you run a Kibana/KQL query for that request_id and paste the narrowest query we should run?
Sam (sre): Use this KQL filter in Kibana: `request_id.keyword : \"req_8b7f3a2e\" OR headers.request_id : \"req_8b7f3a2e\"`. If nothing returns, broaden to `trace_id : \"trace-\"` or search by client_ip/time window. Example ES DSL: `{"query": {"bool": {"should": [{"term": {"request_id.keyword": "req_8b7f3a2e"}}, {"term": {"headers.request_id.keyword": "req_8b7f3a2e"}}]}}}`
Maya (support): Good — if Kibana returns nothing, what are the next steps?
Sam (sre): If no indexed hits: 1) confirm the customer timestamp and timezone (logs indexed by ingestion time), 2) run a wider time window +/- 5m, 3) check routing shard by region (us-east-1) and `client_id` if provided. If still nothing, create an ops-log-archive ticket with request_id and we'll pull from cold storage (note: cold pull ~2-8 hours).
Liam (eng-oncall): Also check edge runtime logs for that request_id; sometimes the error is in the proxy and not in the model worker. KQL for edge: `env:edge AND request_id.keyword:\"req_8b7f3a2e\"`
Maya (support): Jane — can you confirm the exact timestamp (ISO) when the request was sent and provide the full response headers? That helps SRE narrow shards.
Jane (Acme): Timestamp was 2025-11-12T14:23:11Z. Full headers pasted above plus we have a curl -v log — attaching in thread.
debug-bot: debug-bundle created: https://internal.debug/redwood/ bundles/dbg-20251112-55a2 (expires in 7 days)
Liam (eng-oncall): I grabbed the debug bundle link, starting trace linkages. If SRE finds nothing in indexed logs, please escalate to ops-log-archive and cc eng-oncall.
Sam (sre): Found one hit in worker logs at ingestion time 2025-11-12T14:23:12Z, truncated stack: `NullPointer at com.redwood.inference.Worker.handleRequest(Worker.java:512)` — will paste sanitized snippet to the ticket.
Maya (support): Thanks Sam — creating ticket SUP-4621 to pull full raw logs and link to the customer case. Jane — we may need your consent to grab payload contents for debugging (PII check). Please ACK.
Jane (Acme): ACK, please proceed.
Maya (support): Follow-up plan: 1) Sam to attach full sanitized logs to SUP-4621, 2) Liam to triage root cause (likely worker null check), 3) support to update customer with ETA (target 8 business hours).
Liam (eng-oncall): I'll open an eng bug if stack shows missing guard. Tagging @oncall-team. :thumbsup:
Maya (support): Closing loop here once SUP-4621 has artifacts. Thanks everyone.
